title: terebinthus pannosa
intro: Terebinthus pannosa, commonly known as Bristle bush, is a plant species that belongs to the family Anacardiaceae. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties that can aid in wound healing, reducing pain and inflammation, and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Terebinthus pannosa include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antifungal and antiviral activities, and exert a relaxing effect on the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
